body:
Hi,

> The reason, as far as I understand, is that the cjxl encoder bundled in ART-imageio looks for a library (libz) in an hardcoded path /opt/local/lib, which is not present on my machine (again, probably because it's Macports specific).

Indeed, I never noticed that. Thanks for reporting! It should be fixed now.

> bundle_ART.py, which is what I ultimately use, assumes a Macports system

I still don't think this is true. There were a couple of giltches due to trying to copy the same library multiple times, but once fixed that, it should work. In fact, I just tried on a VM with homebrew instead of macports, and for me the following steps result in a working ART app bundle with all the bells and whistles (including a custom GTK+ that is installed in `/opt/local`, not interefering with the one provided by homebrew). As usual though, YMMV.

```bash
brew install \
	gtkmm3 \
	gtk-mac-integration \
	little-cms2 \
	meson \
	cmake \
	fftw \
	exiv2 \
	lensfun \
	pkgconfig \
	automake \
	libtool \
	opencolorio \
	librsvg \
	simde \
	adwaita-icon-theme \
	libomp \
	ctl

git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw.git
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw-cmake.git
pushd LibRaw
ln -s ../LibRaw-cmake/CMakeLists.txt
ln -s ../LibRaw-cmake/cmake
mkdir build
cd build
cmake .. \
	-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
	-DENABLE_X3FTOOLS=1 \
	-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/opt/local \
	-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-Xpreprocessor -fopenmp -DLIBRAW_USE_OPENMP=1 -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include" \
	-DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -lomp" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib -lomp"
make -j4
sudo make install
popd

curl -O https://download.gnome.org/sources/gtk+/3.24/gtk%2B-3.24.43.tar.xz
tar xJf gtk%2B-3.24.43.tar.xz
pushd gtk+-3.24.43
patch -p1 < ~/src/ART/tools/osx/gdk-window-quartz-colorspace.patch
meson setup build \
	-Dbuildtype=release \
	-Dprefix=/opt/local \
	-Ddemos=false \
	-Dexamples=false \
	-Dtests=false \
	-Dx11_backend=false \
	-Dintrospection=false \
	-Dc_args=-I/opt/homebrew/include \
	-Dc_link_args=-I/opt/homebrew/lib
cd build
meson compile
sudo meson install
popd

curl -O https://exiftool.org/ver.txt
curl -O https://exiftool.org/ExifTool-$(cat ver.txt).pkg
sudo installer -pkg ExifTool-$(cat ver.txt).pkg -target /

pushd ~/src/ART
mkdir build
cd build
export C_FLAGS="-Xpreprocessor -fopenmp /opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib/libomp.dylib -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/include"
cmake .. \
	-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
	-DENABLE_CTL=1 \
	-DENABLE_LIBRAW=1 \
	-DENABLE_SIMDE=1 \
	-DOpenMP_C_FLAGS="$C_FLAGS" \
	-DOpenMP_CXX_FLAGS="$C_FLAGS" \
	-DOpenMP_C_LIB_NAMES=libomp \
	-DOpenMP_CXX_LIB_NAMES=libomp \
	-DOpenMP_libomp_LIBRARY=/opt/homebrew/opt/libomp/lib/libomp.dylib \
	-DCTL_INCLUDE_DIR=/opt/homebrew/include/CTL \
	-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/include -Wno-unused-command-line-argument -Wno-deprecated-register -Wno-unknown-warning-option"
make -j4 install

cd Release/ART.app
python3 ~/src/ART/tools/osx/bundle_ART.py -o ~/src -v -r /opt/local/lib -n -p /opt/homebrew -I -e
```
